import urllib.request, json, urllib.parse, time, os
base='https://jaspar.elixir.no/api/v1/matrix/?collection=CORE&format=json&page_size=1000&page='
all=[]
for page in range(1,6):
    url=base+str(page)
    data=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=60))
    all += data['results']
    if not data.get('next'):
        break
# target names with case-insensitive exact match and alias mapping
targets={'FOXA1':'FOXA1','GATA3':'GATA3','MAX':'MAX','STAT1':'STAT1','OCT4':'POU5F1','P53':'TP53','NANOG':'NANOG','HNF4A':'HNF4A','TBP':'TBP','FOS':'FOS','MYC':'MYC','JUN':'JUN','FOXO1':'FOXO1','CTCF':'CTCF','TCF7':'TCF7','SOX2':'SOX2','E2F1':'E2F1','CREB1':'CREB1','GATA1':'GATA1','KLF3':'KLF3'}
# normalize names upper
for alias, real in list(targets.items()):
    targets[alias] = real.upper()
selected=[]
for m in all:
    if m.get('tax_group')"'!='"'vertebrates':
        continue
    nm=m.get('name','').upper()
    if nm in targets.values():
        selected.append(m)
print('selected',len(selected))
# sort by real then version numeric
for alias,real in targets.items():
    sel=[m for m in selected if m['name'].upper()==real]
    print(alias, real, [m['matrix_id'] for m in sel])
# Fetch meme for each selected
blocks=[]
header_lines=None
for m in selected:
    mid=m['matrix_id']
    txt=urllib.request.urlopen('https://jaspar.elixir.no/api/v1/matrix/'+urllib.parse.quote(mid)+'.meme',timeout=60).read().decode()
    lines=txt.splitlines()
    # find first MOTIF line and take from there
    motif_start=None
    for i,l in enumerate(lines):
        if l.startswith('MOTIF '):
            motif_start=i; break
    if motif_start is None:
        print('no MOTIF',mid); continue
    if header_lines is None:
        header_lines=lines[:motif_start]
    block='\\n'.join(lines[motif_start:])
    # ensure single trailing newline
    blocks.append(block.strip()+'\\n')
content='\\n'.join(header_lines).rstrip()+'\\n\\n'+'\\n'.join(blocks)
# write
out='/workspace/jaspar_candidate_motifs.meme'
open(out,'w').write(content)
print('wrote',out,'size',os.path.getsize(out),'motifs',len(blocks))
print(content[:500])
print('...tail...')
print(content[-500:])
PY"

selected=[]
for alias,qname in aliases.items():
    url='https://jaspar.elixir.no/api/v1/matrix/?search='+urllib.parse.quote(qname)+'&collection=CORE&format=json&page_size=100'
    data=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=60))
    target=qname.upper()
    for m in data['results']:
        if m.get('name','').upper()"'!=target:
            continue
        mid=m['"'matrix_id']
        # fetch detail to get tax_group
        try:
            d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('https://jaspar.elixir.no/api/v1/matrix/'+urllib.parse.quote(mid)+'/',timeout=60))
        except Exception as e:
            print('detail err',mid,e); continue
        if d.get('tax_group')"'!='"'vertebrates':

            continue

        print('keep',alias,mid,d.get('name'),d.get('tax_group'))
print('selected',len(selected))
# sort by alias order then matrix id
order={alias:i for i,alias in enumerate(aliases)}
selected.sort(key=lambda d:(order[[a for a,q in aliases.items() if q.upper()==d['name'].upper()][0]], d['matrix_id']))
# fetch MEME blocks
header_lines=None; blocks=[]

    mid=d['matrix_id']

    start=None
    for i,l in enumerate(lines):
        if l.startswith('MOTIF '):
            start=i;break
    if start is None:
        print('no motif',mid); continue
    if header_lines is None:
        header_lines=lines[:start]
    blocks.append('\\n'.join(lines[start:]).strip()+'\\n')
content='\\n'.join(header_lines).rstrip()+'\\n\\n'+'\\n'.join(blocks)
out='/workspace/jaspar_candidate_motifs.meme'
open(out,'w').write(content)
print('wrote',out,'size',os.path.getsize(out),'motif blocks',len(blocks))
print(content[:600])
print(content[-600:])
